raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X), the native MXFP8 MoE `fused_experts_mxfp8` (`tl.dot_scaled` grouped GEMM) only
implements the MiniMax-M3 SwiGLU-OAI activation. A standard SiLU-gated MoE model in MXFP8 (1x32 blocks, UE8M0
scales), such as Qwen3-30B-A3B, cannot be served at all. With `--moe-runner-backend triton` (the gfx950 MXFP8
default when `--quantization mxfp8` is given), the first forward raises:

```
NotImplementedError: native MXFP8 MoE expects uninterleaved (split) gate/up layout.
```

The check fires because Qwen3-MoE leaves `gate_up_interleaved` at its default `True`. That flag only describes
SwiGLU weights, though: for plain SiLU, `FusedMoE` loads w13 as `[gate; up]`, the split layout the kernel's
GEMMs already read. Only the activation between the two GEMMs is M3-specific.

## Modifications

- `fused_experts_mxfp8`: when neither `gemm1_alpha` nor `gemm1_limit` is set, select plain `silu(gate) * up`
  and skip the interleave check. DeepSeek-V4's `swiglu_limit` clamp is not implemented here, so it is rejected
  instead of being dropped silently.
- `fused_moe_mxfp8_native`: `alpha=None` applies `silu_and_mul` to the GEMM1 output, then the same MXFP8
  quantization as before GEMM2.
- The SwiGLU-OAI path (MiniMax-M3 passes `gemm1_alpha=config.swiglu_alpha`) is unchanged: on identical inputs,
  `fused_experts_mxfp8` with SwiGLU-OAI arguments returns bitwise-identical outputs to `main` in 120/120 cases:
  5 shapes, 6 argument sets (M3 with and without the clamp, default alpha with the clamp, `no_combine`,
  `expert_map`, `routed_scaling_factor`), and all 4 combinations of `SGLANG_MINIMAX_M3_FUSED_SWIGLU_MXFP8` and
  `SGLANG_MINIMAX_M3_FUSED_MOE_COMBINE`.
- Test: `test_mxfp8_native_moe_plain_silu` calls `fused_experts_mxfp8` with the Qwen3-MoE runner defaults and
  compares against a dequantized BF16 reference.

Not in scope:
- With `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` (the ROCm image default) and neither `--quantization mxfp8` nor
  `--moe-runner-backend triton`, the `auto` runner still resolves to aiter, whose MXFP8 MoE only supports
  SwiGLU-OAI (`NotImplementedError: AITER MXFP8 MoE only supports swiglu-oai alpha=1.702, got gemm1_alpha=None.`).
  Pass one of the two flags.
- The native kernel still needs the per-rank MoE intermediate size to be a multiple of 128. For Qwen3-30B-A3B
  (768) that means TP1 or TP2, or TP4 with `--ep-size 4`.

## Accuracy Tests

Qwen3-30B-A3B converted to MXFP8, and to 128x128 block FP8 for comparison. Tested on MI350X with
`rocm/sgl-dev:miles-rocm10-mi35x-20261019` and this branch's Python sources. Offline `sgl.Engine`; MXFP8 runs
use `moe_runner_backend="triton"`, the others use the default runner.

GSM8K, first 250 test questions, greedy, non-thinking chat template, 768 new tokens:

| Model | Accuracy |
|---|---|
| BF16, TP1 | 92.4% |
| Block FP8, TP1 | 94.0% |
| MXFP8, TP1 | 94.4% (`main`: NotImplementedError) |
| MXFP8, TP2 | 94.8% |
| MXFP8, TP4 + EP4 | 94.8% |

BF16 and block FP8 do not reach the changed code; they were run on this branch.

Log-prob agreement with BF16 (TP1). 16 fixed prompts with 128-token BF16 greedy completions (1748 tokens),
each re-scored by prefill on every model:

| Model | mean abs dlogprob | p99 abs dlogprob | argmax == BF16 greedy token |
|---|---|---|---|
| BF16 (reference) | 0 | 0 | 99.1% |
| Block FP8 | 0.023 | 0.30 | 97.6% |
| MXFP8 (this PR) | 0.025 | 0.34 | 97.8% |

For BF16, the argmax column compares its prefill argmax with its own greedy decode; its prefill and decode log-probs differ by 0.011 mean / 0.14 p99 abs.

Kernel tests, `python -m pytest test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_minimax_m3_mxfp8.py` on MI350X: 2 failed
and 16 passed before the change (the new cases hit the `NotImplementedError` above), 18 passed after.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Decode throughput, TP1, 512 random input tokens, 256 output tokens with `ignore_eos`, output tok/s:

| Model / MoE runner | bs 1 | bs 8 | bs 32 | bs 128 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BF16 / aiter (default) | 199 | 1065 | 3247 | 8116 |
| Block FP8 / aiter (default) | 181 | 1081 | 3702 | 9705 |
| Block FP8 / triton | 149 | 887 | 2862 | 8553 |
| MXFP8 / triton (this PR) | 118 | 758 | 2584 | 7610 |
| MXFP8 MoE / triton, dense layers converted to block FP8 (`SGLANG_FORCE_MXFP8_BLOCK_CONVERT_DENSE=1`) | 149 | 852 | 3115 | 8787 |

The MXFP8 MoE runs at the speed of the Triton block-FP8 MoE. The extra gap at small batch comes from the dense
MXFP8 linears, which this PR does not touch.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -9,7 +9,8 @@
   * tokens are sorted by expert with ``moe_align_block_size``;
   * GEMM1 reads the activation by token-id indirection (``a_row = token // top_k``)
     so the hidden states are MXFP8-quantized exactly ONCE (not top_k times);
-  * the SwiGLU-OAI activation is the fused fp32 Triton kernel (split layout);
+  * the activation (SiLU-and-mul, or the fused fp32 SwiGLU-OAI Triton kernel)
+    reads the split gate/up layout;
   * GEMM2 applies the top-k weight inside the kernel and writes each route to a
     distinct output row (no atomics); the final reduction is a strided sum.
 """
@@ -253,7 +254,7 @@ def fused_moe_mxfp8_native(
     topk_weights: torch.Tensor,  # [T, top_k]
     topk_ids: torch.Tensor,  # [T, top_k] (local expert ids; -1 for non-local EP)
     *,
-    alpha: float,
+    alpha: Optional[float],
     beta: float,
     limit: Optional[float],
     no_combine: bool = False,
@@ -262,6 +263,7 @@ def fused_moe_mxfp8_native(
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
     # Lazy import: the jit_kernel package pulls in Triton at first use; importing
     # at call time avoids any import-time cycle with the moe runner package.
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.activation import silu_and_mul
     from sglang.kernels.ops.activation.minimax_m3_swiglu import (
         swiglu_oai_mxfp8_quant,
         swiglu_oai_split,
@@ -310,7 +312,9 @@ def fused_moe_mxfp8_native(
         a_div=top_k,
     )  # [M, 2I]
 
-    if envs.SGLANG_MINIMAX_M3_FUSED_SWIGLU_MXFP8.get():
+    if alpha is None:
+        act_q, act_s = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(silu_and_mul(g1))
+    elif envs.SGLANG_MINIMAX_M3_FUSED_SWIGLU_MXFP8.get():
         # SwiGLU-OAI (split layout) + MiniMax MXFP8 quant in one kernel, fp32 all
         # the way to the E8M0 scale (no bf16 activation round-trip; matches the
         # vLLM/ame fused kernel). Opt-in until full-model accuracy is re-qualified.
@@ -389,30 +393,36 @@ def fused_experts_mxfp8(
     """Native MXFP8 MoE entry (CDNA4 ``dot_scaled``).
 
     Keeps the SGLang ``fused_experts_mxfp8`` call contract but routes to the
-    single grouped-GEMM kernel. Only the MiniMax-M3 SwiGLU-OAI (split,
-    uninterleaved, gated silu with ``gemm1_alpha``/``gemm1_limit``) configuration
-    is supported -- the unsupported cases below never occur on the M3 path.
+    single grouped-GEMM kernel. Supports gated silu: plain ``silu(gate) * up``
+    when neither ``gemm1_alpha`` nor ``gemm1_limit`` is set, otherwise the
+    MiniMax-M3 SwiGLU-OAI (split, uninterleaved) configuration.
     """
     if not (activation == "silu" and is_gated):
         raise NotImplementedError(
-            f"native MXFP8 MoE only supports gated swiglu-oai, got "
-            f"{activation=} {is_gated=}."
+            f"native MXFP8 MoE only supports gated silu, got {activation=} {is_gated=}."
         )
     if b1 is not None or b2 is not None:
         raise NotImplementedError("native MXFP8 MoE does not support expert bias.")
     if apply_router_weight_on_input:
         raise NotImplementedError(
             "native MXFP8 MoE does not support apply_router_weight_on_input."
         )
-    if gate_up_interleaved:
-        raise NotImplementedError(
-            "native MXFP8 MoE expects uninterleaved (split) gate/up layout."
-        )
-
-    # SwiGLU-OAI default activation alpha (gpt-oss); M3 may override via gemm1_alpha.
-    alpha = 1.702 if gemm1_alpha is None else float(gemm1_alpha)
+    if gemm1_alpha is None and gemm1_limit is None:
+        # gate_up_interleaved only describes swiglu weights; plain silu w13 is
+        # [gate; up], as in the triton fused_moe silu_and_mul path.
+        if swiglu_limit is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("native MXFP8 MoE does not support swiglu_limit.")
+        alpha = None
+        limit = None
+    else:
+        if gate_up_interleaved:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "native MXFP8 MoE expects uninterleaved (split) gate/up layout."
+            )
+        # SwiGLU-OAI default activation alpha (gpt-oss); M3 may override via gemm1_alpha.
+        alpha = 1.702 if gemm1_alpha is None else float(gemm1_alpha)
+        limit = None if gemm1_limit is None else float(gemm1_limit)
     beta = 1.0
-    limit = None if gemm1_limit is None else float(gemm1_limit)
     # NOTE: routed_scaling_factor is intentionally NOT re-applied here. For M3
     # (sigmoid routing with apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output=True) it is
     # already folded into topk_weights by the topk kernel; re-applying would

@@ -177,7 +177,10 @@ def _ref_moe(x, w13, w2, topk_weights, topk_ids, alpha, beta, limit):
             if limit is not None:
                 gate = gate.clamp(max=limit)
                 up = up.clamp(min=-limit, max=limit)
-            act = gate * torch.sigmoid(alpha * gate) * (up + beta)
+            if alpha is None:
+                act = torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up
+            else:
+                act = gate * torch.sigmoid(alpha * gate) * (up + beta)
             g2 = act @ w2[e].float().T  # [H]
             out[t] += topk_weights[t, j].float() * g2
     return out.to(x.dtype)
@@ -226,6 +229,37 @@ def test_mxfp8_native_moe(T, H, inter, E, top_k):
     assert _relerr(got, ref) < 5e-2
 
 
+@requires_gfx950
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "T,H,inter,E,top_k", [(8, 256, 512, 8, 2), (33, 512, 384, 16, 4)]
+)
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_mxfp8_native_moe_plain_silu(T, H, inter, E, top_k):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.mxfp8_moe_amd_gfx95 import fused_experts_mxfp8
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    w13_bf16 = torch.randn(E, 2 * inter, H, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1
+    w2_bf16 = torch.randn(E, H, inter, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1
+    w13_fp8, w13_scale = _mxfp8_e4m3_quantize_torch(w13_bf16)
+    w2_fp8, w2_scale = _mxfp8_e4m3_quantize_torch(w2_bf16)
+
+    x = torch.randn(T, H, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5
+    logits = torch.randn(T, E, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)
+    topk_weights, topk_ids = logits.softmax(dim=-1).topk(top_k, dim=-1)
+    topk_ids = topk_ids.to(torch.int32)
+
+    # Runner defaults of a standard SiLU-gated MoE (e.g. Qwen3-MoE): no
+    # gemm1_alpha / gemm1_limit, gate_up_interleaved left at True.
+    got = fused_experts_mxfp8(
+        x, w13_fp8, w2_fp8, topk_weights, topk_ids, w13_scale, w2_scale
+    )
+    w13_deq = dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16(w13_fp8, w13_scale)
+    w2_deq = dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16(w2_fp8, w2_scale)
+    ref = _ref_moe(x, w13_deq, w2_deq, topk_weights, topk_ids, None, None, None)
+    assert got.shape == (T, H)
+    assert _relerr(got, ref) < 5e-2
+
+

 @torch.inference_mode()
 def test_mxfp8_native_moe_ep_expert_map_filters_non_local_routes():
